source: PLAN §8.5 and §10 conversation subset (R-01); prototype Nouri App.dc.html SCRIPT and FINAL

rules.walk: Turns run in order. A turn is asked when at least one of its questions is applicable (branching rules in questions.v1.json) and has no status yet. Otherwise it is skipped silently.
rules.skipWhen: When a turn's skipWhen condition is true the whole turn is skipped, even if a question in it would otherwise be asked. Same grammar as questions.v1.json conditionGrammar.
rules.partialAnswers: If a reply answers only some questions in the group, Milo asks the rest one at a time with askOne lines before moving to the next turn. A question the user declines is saved as skipped and never asked again in this conversation.
rules.provisional: Questions listed in provisional are asked ahead of the question their branching rule depends on (q08 and q09 come before q07 in conversation). Hold their values on the device without saving. Commit them when the branching rules show them after the dependency is answered; otherwise drop them without storing (they are never saved for under-18 or unknown age). See OQ-21.
rules.lineComposition: Milo's spoken line = the model's short ack (max 1 sentence) + the canonical miloLine or askOne text from this file. Canonical lines are pre-rendered as audio under tts/{version}/conversation.turnN.mp3.
rules.chips: Chips are equal to voice and typed replies. A chip with sets saves those answers directly (inputMethod chip, confidence 1) without a model call. A chip with skips saves those questions as skipped.
rules.confirmation: Every turn that extracts more than one answer, and every answer with confidence below 0.7, shows the confirm step before anything is saved (PLAN §8.5.4).
rules.sensitive: q06, q07, q08 and q09 MUST come from an explicit statement in this conversation. Never infer them from a name, voice, photo or other answers. q07 is always its own turn with chips, even by voice.
rules.deferred: Skip to my plan, or reaching the end, opens Review. Every question in questions.v1.json not answered or skipped here is stored as deferred and drives the Finish setting up card.
rules.degraded: If extraction returns AI_UNAVAILABLE, show Milo line onboarding.degraded and open the manual form at the current turn's first unanswered question with the answers so far.

confirm.template: Here's what I noted: {summary}. Is that right?
confirm.onChange: No problem. What should I change?

skipToPlan.label: Skip to my plan
skipToPlan.behaviour: Ends the conversation and opens Review with the answers so far.

turns.miloLine: I'll ask a few simple questions, and you can answer however feels natural. We'll use what you tell me to build a plan that fits your routine. Ready to begin?
turns.notes: No extraction. Any reply moves on; a question from the user is answered briefly first.

turns.miloLine: What should I call you, and what would you most like help with right now?

askOne.q05: What should I call you? A nickname is perfect.
askOne.q01: What would you most like to work on right now? Help me decide is a fine answer too.

turns.notes: q01 is required (BR-10): if declined, ask askOne.q01 once more, then save decide only if the user agrees.

turns.miloLine: Tell me a little about yourself: your age, height and current weight. Skip anything you'd rather not share.

askOne.q06: How old are you? A plain age is fine, or you can skip it.
askOne.q09: And your most recent weight? A rough number is fine.

turns.notes: Ask for age first if the user gives only height or weight. If the stated age is under 18 or age is declined, drop q08 and q09 without saving and skip turns 4–6. 'About' or 'roughly' on weight sets isEstimate true.

turns.miloLine: Some calorie equations use a sex input. Which should we use for your estimate, if any?
turns.notes: Always its own explicit question, even by voice (PLAN §8.5.6). After this turn commit or drop the provisional q08 and q09 from turn 3.

turns.miloLine: Is there a weight you'd like to work toward? Not sure yet is fine.
turns.notes: Only when rule BR-TW shows target_weight (q01 lose or gain, with sex input, height and weight). Display only; never a deadline. Ack must not praise a specific number.

turns.miloLine: How active is a typical day for you?
turns.notes: Prototype had three chips; four activity chips plus Not sure keep a one-to-one mapping to q10 options.

turns.miloLine: Do you follow a particular way of eating, like vegetarian or vegan? And where do most of your meals come from?

askOne.q11: Do you follow a particular way of eating, like vegetarian or vegan?
askOne.q12: Where do most of your meals come from?

turns.notes: A diet label is not an allergy or medical statement. Foods the user dislikes (for example 'not big on spicy food') are not an answer to q11; acknowledge them only.

turns.miloLine: What usually makes healthy eating difficult during your day?
turns.notes: Multi: a reply may map to several options (respect exclusive none). Never diagnose; support, not pressure.

turns.miloLine: Last one. How would you like to add meals: a photo, your voice, typing, or entering it yourself?
turns.notes: switch and later are exclusive. q31 is never asked in conversation; it stays deferred.

final.text: I have what I need, {name}. Let me put your plan together.
final.textNoName: I have what I need. Let me put your plan together.
final.habitsOnly: I have what I need, {name}. Let me put your starting routine together.
final.habitsOnlyNoName: I have what I need. Let me put your starting routine together.
final.notes: Prototype FINAL began with a reply-specific sentence; in production that sentence is the model's ack for the last turn.

active: gym a few times a week

units.conversion: 1 in = 2.54 cm; 1 m = 100 cm; 1 lb = 0.45359237 kg; 1 st = 14 lb. Store height as cm with unit cm or ft_in, weight as kg with unit kg or lb (stone answers display as lb until a stone display unit exists, OQ-24). Out-of-range values (height 90–250 cm, weight 25–300 kg, age 10–110) are confirmed with the user, never silently corrected.
